# A bell-bloom: the springy flower. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Stalk --base-color 0.216 0.580 0.431 --no-slot
material new Petal --base-color 0.851 0.341 0.388 --no-slot
material new Gold --base-color 0.984 0.949 0.212 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --vertices 6 --radius 0.045 --depth 0.3 --name Stem --location 0 0 0.15
apply --location
material assign Stalk
add mesh torus --major-segments 8 --minor-segments 4 --major-radius 0.13 --minor-radius 0.04 --name Coil1 --location 0 0 0.08
apply --location
material assign Stalk
add mesh torus --major-segments 8 --minor-segments 4 --major-radius 0.13 --minor-radius 0.04 --name Coil2 --location 0 0 0.2
apply --location
material assign Stalk
add mesh cone --vertices 8 --radius1 0.09 --radius2 0.31 --depth 0.22 --name Cup --location 0 0 0.39
apply --location
material assign Petal
add mesh cylinder --vertices 8 --radius 0.2 --depth 0.04 --name Heart --location 0 0 0.48
apply --location
material assign Gold
select Cup Stem Coil1 Coil2 Heart
active Cup
join
rename Cup Spring
select all
shade flat
export spring.glb
